name: insight-engine
description: YouTube 영상으로 AI 블로그 포스트 자동 생성

scripts.verify:backend: node scripts/run_python.cjs -m pytest tests --ignore=tests/e2e --tb=short --timeout=60 -p no:warnings -p no:cacheprovider -q && node scripts/run_python.cjs -m flake8 . --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --exclude=__pycache__,migrations,node_modules,.venv,.next --count --show-source --statistics
scripts.verify:frontend: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm test && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:e2e
